title: Opt-in provenance capture hook (fail-open) feeding the hk ledger
description: PreToolUse/PostToolUse hook that appends session-created artifacts (new files, branches, worktrees, containers, background commands) to a gitignored per-session ledger. Disabled unless enabled in .housekeeping.toml. Exits 0 on every failure path.

acceptanceCriteria.text: hook is registered in hooks/hooks.json and is a no-op unless [provenance] enabled = true
hook exits 0 on malformed input, missing config, and unwritable ledger, proven by tests
ledger entries are consumed by hk inventory as provenance=ledger
